description: Roosendaal's strength S(n) = 5*O(n) - 3*E(n) and level L(n) = -floor(S(n)/8) create a topological partition of integers. Only 5 strength records known. Numbers at extreme negative levels are extraordinarily rare.
mathematical_formalization: Level l density decreases super-exponentially: density(l) ~ exp(-alpha * l^2). The next strength record (level -5 or below) should appear near 10^21.
analogical_connections: Electron shell levels in quantum mechanics
implementation_hypothesis: Build database of all level <= -1 numbers up to 10^16. Extrapolate density function to predict smallest level -5 number.
experiment_seed: Count numbers at each level l in [-4, 0] for ranges [10^k, 10^{k+1}], k = 12..16. Fit density function.
